title: Native Implicit Resource Items
objective: Resolve declared indexed operations for constructor-inferred native FFI resources without requiring unused type imports

oracles: IR equivalence for explicit versus constructor-only resource imports
Existing FFI declaration qualification and source provenance checks

handoff.summary: Constructor-inferred FFI resources now use the same declaration-qualified indexed operations as explicitly imported resource types. Annotation visibility and private native import rules are unchanged. Six focused lowering/core-emission tests pass; the full changed-file qualification is still running.
risks: The compiler changes invalidate content-addressed native artifacts and the optimizer evidence fingerprint; integration must regenerate and qualify current artifacts.
Full native and cross-platform qualification is pending; this lane remains active and its PR is draft.
